proposedRegistryTrack.why: The registry has no Maine pardon/clemency track, although it carries pardon tracks in other jurisdictions (e.g. ak-pardon, al-pardon). The Maine mechanism — executive pardon rendering the conviction confidential rather than erased — has no track.

evidence.value: pardon renders conviction confidential criminal-history information
evidence.quote: A full and free pardon in Maine does not wipe the record clean. Maines Department of Corrections Pardon Board states that Maine does not expunge or erase criminal records and that a pardon makes the pardoned conviction confidential criminal-history information, available only under limited statutory conditions. ("https://www.maine.gov/corrections/pardonboard")

evidence.value: no ME registry track covers pardon or clemency
evidence.quote: ME registry tracks: me-deferred, me-nonconv, me-screening, me-seal-gen, me-seal-prost, me-seal-survivor — none is a pardon or clemency track and none cites the Pardon Board or clemency authority.

findings.reasoning: The compiled pathway is the Maine executive-pardon route, sourced in the profile to the DOC Pardon Board's official page, with the pardoned conviction becoming confidential criminal-history information under the Title 16 framework. No ME registry track covers pardon or clemency. The profile carries no statutory citation for the clemency power itself (a constitutional power), so the gap is recorded with the Pardon Board authority and the § 703 confidentiality consequence; confidence medium on citation granularity, high on the gap itself.

evidence.quote: Maine enacted Public Law 2025, Chapter 513, effective without the Governors signature on January 11, 2026, creating a broader survivor-based sealing route for victims of sex trafficking or sexual exploitation. … Under the new 2262-B route, criminal history record information relating to any current or former crime may be sealed
me-seal-survivor: Motion to Seal Conviction for Victims of Sex Trafficking or Sexual Exploitation (15 M.R.S. § 2262-B) — authority 15 M.R.S. § 2262-B, § 2261(6)(C), § 2261(8), § 2261(9)

findings.reasoning: The compiled pathway cites the operative statute § 2262-B directly ('Under the new 2262-B route') together with its session law, Public Law 2025 ch. 513 — the exact authority of registry track me-seal-survivor. Direct statutory identity.
